item.title: Watch Newsround
item.description: All the latest news for children, in one short bulletin.

item.title: Teen author wins prize for her first novel about a lighthouse
item.description: Fourteen-year-old Amira wrote the book in her school library at lunchtimes, and it has now won a national award.

item.title: Lionesses name squad for autumn matches
item.description: England's women's football team have named three new players in their squad ahead of two friendly matches next month.

item.title: Minecraft is getting its first new dimension in 14 years
item.description: The video game's makers say players will be able to explore a brand new world full of floating islands next year.

item.title: Wildcats to be reintroduced to more areas of Scotland
item.description: Conservationists say the rare animals are thriving after being released into the Cairngorms two years ago.

item.title: Seven-year-old's painting to hang in national gallery
item.description: Mia's picture of her grandmother's garden won a competition and will go on display alongside works by famous artists.

item.title: Two teenagers arrested after stabbing near football ground
item.description: Police say two boys have been arrested after the attack outside the stadium on Saturday.

item.title: Signed version: Watch Newsround
item.description: A signed version of Newsround is available every weekday for children who use British Sign Language.

item.title: Poetry competition for young writers opens
item.description: Children across the UK are invited to send in a poem about the place where they live before the end of the year.
